# poetry-2

Generated 2026-11-12 by a real tool in a throwaway container. Neither file was
edited by hand afterwards, and poetry did not change pyproject.toml.

- Tool: Poetry 2.5.1 (latest on PyPI at generation time), installed with pip 25.0.1.
- Image: `python:3.12-slim` (CPython 3.12.16), digest
  `sha256:5e2bdb1b0d542d5039cffb8181c65930093949194a65c365dfb1b0fe13a4fa5b`.
  git 2.47.3 was installed from Debian.
- Commands (pyproject.toml was hand-written first; only `poetry lock` was run, never `poetry install`):

      docker run --rm -v <scratch>/poetry-2:/work -w /work python:3.12-slim sh -c '
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git
        pip install "poetry==2.5.1"
        POETRY_NO_INTERACTION=1 PYTHON_KEYRING_BACKEND=keyring.backends.null.Keyring poetry lock -vv'

  poetry creates an empty virtualenv under `/root/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs` inside the container, and it was discarded with the container. The git dependency's metadata was read statically from its pyproject.toml, so no build backend ran.

Manifest: PEP 621 `[project]` with `requires-python = ">=3.9"`. The main dependencies are in `[project].dependencies`. The git dependency is a PEP 508 direct reference, `sampleproject @ git+https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject@main`. The dev group is `[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]` with `iniconfig = "2.0.0"`. `package-mode = false` is set, so the root project is not in the lock.

Notable features of poetry.lock:
- Header `# This file is automatically @generated by Poetry 2.5.1 ...`. `[metadata]` has `lock-version = "2.1"`, `python-versions = ">=3.9"` and a `content-hash`.
- 9 `[[package]]` entries: certifi 2026.10.23, charset-normalizer 3.5.2, idna 3.20, iniconfig 2.0.0, packaging 24.1, peppercorn 0.6, requests 2.32.3, sampleproject 4.0.0 (git) and urllib3 2.6.3.
- Groups are per package: `groups = ["dev"]` for iniconfig and `groups = ["main"]` for everything else. There is no `category` key and no per-package `markers`.
- Hashes are inline per package: `files = [{file = "<filename>", hash = "sha256:<hex>"}, ...]`. charset-normalizer has 172 entries, every other registry package 2 (wheel + sdist). There is no `[metadata.files]` table.
- urllib3 is 2.6.3, not the newest 2.8.0. 2.8.0 requires Python >=3.10, and poetry picks one version that covers the whole `>=3.9` range.
- Dependency edges are in `[package.dependencies]` (requests → certifi/charset-normalizer/idna/urllib3, sampleproject → peppercorn). Extras are in `[package.extras]`, including PEP 508 markers inside strings (urllib3 `brotli`, `zstd`).
- Git dependency `sampleproject` 4.0.0 has `files = []`, `develop = false` and `[package.source]` = `type = "git"`, `url = "https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject"`, `reference = "main"`, `resolved_reference = "621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc"`.
- Deviation from the request: the git dependency was meant to be pinned at tag `v4.0.0`, but https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject has no tags at all (`git ls-remote` shows only `HEAD` and `refs/heads/main`). The branch `main` was used instead. It resolves to 621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc, "pyproject: prep 4.0.0 (#219)", whose pyproject.toml declares version 4.0.0. That is the commit a v4.0.0 tag would point at.
